title: 第一卷 第386章 纯阳霸体开第一卷 第385章 歪打正着
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 不用他们说，宁天当然也知道，最关键的，还是怎么帮助大明度过雷劫。
他当然也不是鲁莽，更不是凭着一时脑热跑来送死。
在此之前，他脑海中早就分析过了。
斗罗大陆，魂兽所面临的天劫，本质上是神界设下的规则。
这套规则的核心判定标准，是限定魂兽修炼成神。
而它的识别和判断标准，自然也是基于斗罗大陆的修炼体系。
可他宁天，除了二十九级的魂力之外，真正的根基是什么？
是《纯阳白虎功》。
这是系统给的，独立于斗罗大陆修炼体系之外的修仙功法。
它不修魂力，不炼武魂，修的是纯阳之气，炼的是肉身金身。
他也问过了系统，系统的解释也是，神界降下的这套魂兽天劫规则，根本扫描不到《纯阳白虎功》的存在。
而且，宁天冒险踏入雷暴中心，目的也绝不仅是救大明。
纯阳白虎功，他先前已然刚刚突破到第四层，获得了“纯阳霸体”
第四层给他带来的变化，他日用夜用，感受也是最直接的！
他自然想要让纯阳白虎功再进一层。
可再进一层，哪有那么容易？
现在，这二十万年级别的天劫之雷，还是已经被层层削弱了的，不恰好是送上门的顶级淬体材料？
所以说，对宁天来说，救青龙是真，借雷炼体，也是真。
下一刻，宁天走到大明的硕大龙首前。
察觉到宁天得靠近，大明紧闭的龙目缓缓睁开。
那双原本威严灿烂的青金龙目，此刻黯淡无光，布满血丝。
它艰难地转动眼球，视线聚焦在宁天身上。
看清来人的一瞬，大明眼中闪过错愕。
它没想到，这个人类，竟然敢顶着天威踏入这里。
远处的泰坦巨猿被空间锁定，两位九十九级绝世斗罗在岸边干瞪眼。
唯独这个二十九级的大魂师，站在了它面前。
随后，大明呼出一口浊气。
它眼中曾经有的芥蒂，也彻底消散，取而代之的，是一种夹杂着感激与认同的释然。
接着，大明的声音直接在宁天脑海中响起。
“你能来，有这份心，就足够了。”
“这雷毕竟是天劫，天威难测。”
“虽说天劫暂时无视了你，但若你强行干预我体内的雷霆，必遭其噬。”
“你一个大魂师，沾染一丝就会化作飞灰。”
顺着，它深深看了宁天一眼。
“你还是离开吧。”
大明语气平静，带着坦然：
“这是我的劫。”
content_en:
Needless to say, Ning Tian also knew that the most important thing was how to help Daming survive the thunder disaster.
Of course he was not reckless, nor did he come to die just because of a sudden passion.
Before that, he had already analyzed it in his mind.
In the Douluo Continent, the natural disasters faced by soul beasts are essentially the rules set by the God Realm.
The core criterion of this set of rules is to limit the ability of soul beasts to become gods.
And its identification and judgment standards are naturally based on Douluo Continent's cultivation system.
But besides the twenty-ninth level soul power of Ning Tian, ​​what is his true foundation?
It is "Pure Yang White Tiger Technique".
This is a cultivation technique given by the system that is independent of the Douluo Continent's cultivation system.
It does not cultivate soul power or martial soul. It cultivates pure Yang energy and refines the physical body and golden body.
He also asked the system, and the system's explanation was that the set of rules for the Heavenly Tribulation of Soul Beasts descended from the God Realm could not detect the existence of the "Pure Yang White Tiger Technique" at all.
Moreover, Ning Tian ventured into the center of the thunderstorm for more than just saving Daming.
Pure Yang White Tiger Technique, he had just broken through to the fourth level and obtained the "Pure Yang Hegemony Body"
The changes brought to him by the fourth layer can be felt most directly when he uses it day and night!
Naturally, he wanted to advance the Pure Yang White Tiger Skill to another level.
But how can it be so easy to advance to the next level?
Now, this 200,000-year-old Heavenly Tribulation Thunder has been weakened layer by layer. Isn’t it just the top-grade body tempering material delivered to the door?
Therefore, for Ning Tian, ​​saving Qinglong is true, and using thunder to refine his body is also true.
The next moment, Ning Tian walked up to Daming's huge dragon head.
Sensing Ning Tian's approach, Daming's closed eyes slowly opened.
The originally majestic and brilliant lapis lazuli dragon eyes were now dim and covered with bloodshot eyes.
It turned its eyes with difficulty and focused its gaze on Ning Tian.
The moment he saw the person clearly, Da Ming's eyes flashed with astonishment.
It didn't expect that this human being would dare to step here despite the power of God.
The Titan Giant Ape in the distance was locked in space, and the two level 99 peerless Douluo stared at each other on the shore.
Only this twenty-nine-level great soul master stood in front of it.
Then, Daming exhaled a breath of turbidity.
The grudge it once had in its eyes completely dissipated, replaced by a kind of relief mixed with gratitude and recognition.
"Humans..."
Then, Daming's voice sounded directly in Ning Tian's mind.
"It's enough that you can come and have this heart."
"After all, this thunder is a natural disaster, and the power of God is unpredictable."
"Although the Heavenly Tribulation has ignored you for the time being, if you forcefully interfere with the thunder in my body, you will be devoured by it."
"You are a great soul master, and you will turn into fly ash if you are even contaminated by it."
Following it, it took a deep look at Ning Tian.
"You'd better leave."
Daming's tone was calm and calm:
"This is my disaster."
